claims.note_claim: Configurable user-algorithm framework, distinct actual and predicted preference/score state, actual values hidden from recommender; researcher-configured distributions/scoring/behavior.

Predict/present/feedback/model-update/metrics order; presentation policy configurable; no-interaction events skipped; default one feedback per user per step; parallel user processing; no fixed time duration asserted.
claims.result: Supported; event loop correctly labels its omissions of creator production/adaptation, dynamic user updates, and separate start-up phase.

claims.note_claim: Default independent Bernoulli item attributes and optional production probability; configurable creator adaptation; dynamic preference uses spherical interpolation; default start-up random presentation and end-phase training.
claims.result: Supported and correctly distinguished from framework-wide mandates.

claims.note_claim: Algorithmic confounding replication settings, matched controls, Jaccard outcome and findings.
claims.result: Supported; note describes conceptual replication and gives the reported setting/outcome without generalizing beyond that metric.

claims.note_claim: Structural-virality network size reduction, alpha/r grids, infection/recovery setup, cascade threshold, simulation count and reported values.
claims.result: Supported; one-million-user replication is distinguished from 25-million-user original.

claims.note_claim: Adaptive creator initialization/distribution, last-step interaction-driven adaptation, six recommenders, 200 trials/500 steps, entropy and distance outcomes, interpretation caveat.
claims.result: Supported as one hypothesized constructive extension; note preserves the source's qualification that within-creator narrowing is not necessarily harmful and differs from between-creator convergence.

claims.note_claim: Scope is conceptual/constructive replication, with operationalization ambiguity; applicability to recommender-mediated systems does not validate real behavior.

conflicts_or_gaps: The two first case studies are conceptual replications, and the article reports operationalization ambiguities; the note discloses this scope.
Adaptive creator behavior is a hypothesized mechanism demonstrated in a case study, not a universal empirically established law.
Appendix A.1.1 defers some unspecified distribution hyperparameters to Chaney et al.; the note does not invent them.
The publication date in note frontmatter differs from the date on the audited v2 source; root should review the metadata separately.
